newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' prices steady in narrow band.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' prices steady in narrow band.

text.p: Indian metals held steady on Wednesday in a narrow price band on limited supply and despite low industrial buying, dealers said.
"Trading volumes were very poor as major players are still out of town celebrating the Diwali festivals," one dealer said.
The markets were closed on Monday and Tuesday for the Diwali festival and Hindu New Year.
Copper was quoted at 11,550 rupees, zinc at 6,250 rupees, lead at 4,650 rupees and aluminium at 7,200 rupees. Nickel and tin were unchanged.
